description: Ask whether a constraint holds (the VerifyConstraint RPC, the REPL's %constraint): against its declared values, or against an object of subjectSymbolId built for the call. The answer is a Verdict: `holds`, the violated `condition`, or an `error` when nothing was decided, with the engine and strength of evidence. The question holds or satisfiable puts it to a solver over the free variables and answers with a witness assignment. The result is the VerifyConstraintResponse as protojson writes it.

arguments.description: positional values for the element's in parameters, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

engine.description: the analysis engine asked, as list_engines names them; empty is auto

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

namedArguments.description: values for the element's in parameters by name, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

question.description: evaluate (the default: one evaluation), holds (prove over every free assignment) or satisfiable (find one satisfying assignment)

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate and evaluate against, or a path from one to a nested object; empty evaluates declared values

symbolId.description: qualified name of the constraint or requirement, definition or usage

name: verify_constraint
